name: Pulseboard
description: How much your agents did: who works now, the turns of the last two weeks and how far each plan window is used.

permissions.agents.status: Shows which agents work and which wait for you
permissions.usage.read: Shows how much of each plan window you have used
permissions.chats.read: Counts the turns your chats start, and shows whether a waiting chat wants an approval or an answer
permissions.terminals.read: Counts the turns the agents in your terminals start
